sections.title: Say where something is
sections.content: Use estar to say where a specific person or thing is. The form changes with the subject.

items.spanish: La mesa está en la cocina.
items.english: The table is in the kitchen.

items.spanish: El sofá está en la sala.
items.english: The sofa is in the living room.

items.spanish: Mis libros están en la habitación.
items.english: My books are in the room.

sections.content: Use estar for a specific thing you can identify: La *mesa* está en la *cocina*.
